$comment: FSRS-7 memory vectors for @intellectif/lk-practice (criterion 3), generated by scripts/memory-vectors.mjs from the library named in `library` with its FSRS-7 preset and fuzz off. Each case starts from a memory with no reviews; each step is a review at `at` (integer epoch ms) with the case retention unless the step names one, then the expected `due`, memory, and retrievability at later times. `options` are fsrsMemoryModel options. Run by src/memory/__tests__/fsrs.test.ts, which compares exactly; another implementation compares floats at a relative 1e-9 and `due` exactly.

cases.name: good three times, each at its due
a lapse after three goods, then good
learning steps: again, again, good, good
easy at every due, up to the maximum interval
options: maximum interval 30 days, steps 5m and 30m, relearning 1h
